label: The background, the Catholic theory and the existence of evil are jointly…, by Model-construction
meaning: An explicit interpretation satisfies every listed commitment: #151's strong prima via model (g moves f, f moves x, g moved in no respect) extended with perfections, privation, God and goods. g is God, has every perfection, can eliminate every evil, and draws the lion's life (f) out of the ass's privation of life (x). The per-evil actual-production relation is an assigned model extension satisfying the disputed stronger commitment; this is not evidence that q.2 a.3 ad 1 establishes that attribution or actual permission.
